study.name: Sundarbans East · pilot window
study.boundaryNote: Analyst-defined rectangular study window around the UNESCO-listed Sundarbans East location; not a sanctuary boundary or the whole Sundarbans.

method: Exploratory screened DetailedQA: MODLAND 0/1 with usefulness <=2 and aerosol <=2; moderate aerosol included; clouds/snow/shadow excluded and land mask; raw NDVI × 0.0001; equal-month means for Jan/Feb/Nov/Dec; all four months required per year; at least 3 complete seasonal years per period; paired pixels only. Nearest-neighbour reprojection for display. Difference is descriptive, not significance or forest-loss attribution.
